output.summary: Project FIRES uses lightweight, heat-protective materials originally developed for astronauts to update firefighter protective gear. Jointly sponsored by NASA and the U.S. Fire Administration, this initiative tests new gear across fourteen municipal fire departments to help reduce injuries and fatalities.
output.quote: A major focus of the effort involves application to the FIRES ensemble of lightweight, fire-resistant, heat-protective materials originally developed for use in astronauts' space suits or in spacecraft components which require thermal protection.
